meta.name: Karmma Calling
meta.description:
What goes around, comes around? Let Karma come calling, she will handle it.

Complete series. On your server: S1 7/7

videos.title: Karm
videos.overview: Karma Talwar's entry into the elite Alibaug circle disturbs high-society queen Indrani Kothari. It soon becomes clear that Karma has a dark past. She is on a mission and has her first target in sight.

videos.title: Bharosa
videos.overview: Karma begins wooing Ahaan Kothari, so Indrani puts her security head Sameer after her. As Karma plots the downfall of her second target, she meets Vedant, her childhood friend.

videos.title: Annyaay
videos.overview: Karma's next target is the man who convicted her dad. Indrani's suspicions increase when Ahaan and Karma meet his ex-girlfriend. Meanwhile, his friend Krish makes an entry.

videos.title: Andhere Raaz
videos.overview: Next, Karma trains her sights on Indrani's trusted psychic healer, who left a deep wound in her as a child. Krish becomes a stumbling block to Ahaan and Karma's relationship.

videos.title: Hisaab Barabar
videos.overview: Ahaan and Karma finally confront each other. Kaushal panics when Dolly threatens him. Moreover, she finds an interesting photograph in her apartment.

videos.title: Dil Aur Dimaag
videos.overview: Kaushal is aghast to watch Dolly's video. Krish tells Ahaan about his parent's equation. Deeply shaken, Ahaan joins Bombil Cafe where Vedant becomes his taskmaster.

videos.title: Vaada
videos.overview: Sameer uncovers a darker secret about Karma's past. While she is living the high life in Alibaug with Ahaan, unbeknownst to her, Ambika Mehra's revenge plan may be at risk.
